premise: Pachycephalosaurus says hello with a gentle bonk of his thick, bony dome, but Stegosaurus's back is all plates, Ankylosaurus is all hard bumps (clonk!) and Beetle is far too tiny — so he learns each friend's own hello: a tail swish, a club wag, a tiny wave.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Ass and the Lapdog' (the copied greeting that goes wrong) turned kind: a good hello fits the friend.
lesson: Greet each friend in the way that suits them.
learning: Pachycephalosaurus had a thick dome of solid bone on top of its head.

en-US.title: A Hello for Everyone
en-US.text: {pachycephalosaurus:enter} Pachycephalosaurus had a big round dome on top of his head, thick and hard, solid bone. {pachycephalosaurus:face happy} And he said hello with it: a gentle little BONK. {stegosaurus:enter} "Hello, Stegosaurus!" {pachycephalosaurus:go to stegosaurus} He trotted over to bonk him, and stopped. Plates, plates, plates, all along Stegosaurus's back. Where does a bonk go? {pachycephalosaurus:face surprised} Stegosaurus smiled shyly {stegosaurus:live swish-tail} and swished his tail. Swish, swish. "That's my hello." {pachycephalosaurus:face happy} So Pachycephalosaurus swished right back. {ankylosaurus:enter} "Hello, Ankylosaurus!" {pachycephalosaurus:go to ankylosaurus} {pachycephalosaurus:live bonk hold} BONK! But Ankylosaurus was all hard bumps. {sfx:clonk} CLONK! {pachycephalosaurus:live bonk resume} Pachycephalosaurus rubbed his bony dome and giggled. [laughs] {ankylosaurus:face happy} "Try mine," said Ankylosaurus, {ankylosaurus:live wag-club} and he wagged his round club. Wag, wag. Then, a tiny voice: "Hello!" It was {beetle:enter} Beetle, much too small for a bonk. {pachycephalosaurus:go to beetle} {beetle:live wave} Beetle waved one little leg, so Pachycephalosaurus bent down low {pachycephalosaurus:live wave} and waved one little hand. [warmly] {stegosaurus:face happy} {beetle:face happy} A swish, a wag, a wave. And for anyone who likes it best… a gentle little {sfx:bonk} BONK.

es-ES.title: Un hola para cada uno
es-ES.text: {pachycephalosaurus:enter} Paquicefalosaurio tenía en la cabeza una cúpula redonda, durísima, de hueso macizo. {pachycephalosaurus:face happy} Y con ella saludaba: con un cabezazo suavecito. ¡TOC! {stegosaurus:enter} —¡Hola, Estegosaurio! {pachycephalosaurus:go to stegosaurus} Fue trotando hacia él y se paró en seco. Placas y más placas por toda su espalda. ¿Dónde se da ahí un cabezazo? {pachycephalosaurus:face surprised} Estegosaurio sonrió, muy tímido, {stegosaurus:live swish-tail} y meneó la cola. Fiu, fiu. —Así saludo yo. {pachycephalosaurus:face happy} Y Paquicefalosaurio le devolvió el saludo con la cola. {ankylosaurus:enter} —¡Hola, Anquilosaurio! {pachycephalosaurus:go to ankylosaurus} {pachycephalosaurus:live bonk hold} ¡TOC! Pero Anquilosaurio estaba lleno de bultos duros. {sfx:clonk} ¡CLONC! {pachycephalosaurus:live bonk resume} Paquicefalosaurio se frotó la cúpula de hueso y se rio. [laughs] {ankylosaurus:face happy} —Prueba el mío —dijo Anquilosaurio, {ankylosaurus:live wag-club} y meneó la maza de su cola. Bam, bam. Y una vocecita: —¡Hola! Era {beetle:enter} Escarabajo, demasiado pequeño para un cabezazo. {pachycephalosaurus:go to beetle} {beetle:live wave} Escarabajo saludó con una patita, así que Paquicefalosaurio se agachó {pachycephalosaurus:live wave} y le saludó con una manita. [warmly] {stegosaurus:face happy} {beetle:face happy} Un meneo, un bam, una patita. Y para quien más le guste… un cabezazo suavecito. {sfx:bonk} ¡TOC!

clonk.prompt: two hard bony heads touching with a hollow comic clonk, like a coconut tapping a rock, playful

bonk.prompt: a soft, gentle comic bonk, like a wooden ball tapping a cushion, playful
